name: mitm-cli
title: MITM Proxy
description: Toggle a local mitmproxy intercept, browse captured HTTP/HTTPS flows, and manage the macOS system proxy and root CA.
author: triuzzi

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Proxy
commands.description: Start or stop mitmproxy and the system proxy

commands.name: status
commands.title: Proxy Status
commands.description: Process, service, proxy and CA state

preferences.name: mitmPath
preferences.title: mitm CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional. Defaults to the script bundled with the extension.
